constitutional_basis: Article XXXVI §2 C11 (economic model with sourced inputs)

SAFE.buyer_meaning: System operates reliably. No intervention needed.
operating_conditions: P50 harvest (10 μW) + normal load + <5% arrhythmia + <100nA leakage
P95 harvest (40 μW) + any load + <5% arrhythmia + any leakage
P50 harvest + low load + any arrhythmia + normal leakage

MARGINAL.criteria: 50% <= uptime < 95%, OR recovery_time 1-4h, OR occasional power gaps
MARGINAL.buyer_meaning: System mostly works but may miss sensing events. Consider load reduction or harvest augmentation.
operating_conditions: P5 harvest (1 μW) + normal load + any arrhythmia
P50 harvest + high power load + degraded leakage (100nA)
P5 harvest + low load + degraded leakage

UNSAFE.criteria: uptime < 50%, OR recovery_time > 4h, OR system death within 24h
UNSAFE.buyer_meaning: System cannot sustain operation. Redesign required (increase harvest, reduce load, or add backup).
operating_conditions: Zero harvest (complete harvesting failure) — death in 0.1h
P5 harvest + degraded leakage + 2x duty cycle

buyer_assumptions.harvest_source: Cardiac motion (LITERATURE_VERIFIED: Zurbuchen 2013, 16.7 μW in-vivo sheep)
buyer_assumptions.load: Sensing: 50μW×1s + 100μW×0.5s = 100μJ per event. RF: 5mW×0.01s = 50μJ per transmission.
buyer_assumptions.duty_cycles: Low (1 sensing/200s, RF/2h), Normal (1/100s, RF/hr), High (1/50s, RF/30min)
buyer_assumptions.arrhythmia_model: 5% of beats have 70% reduced harvest. DISCLOSURE: More aggressive than published 10-30% — our model is conservative (pessimistic).
buyer_assumptions.recovery_model: When capacitor drops below 10% (75μJ), RF transmissions are skipped until capacitor recovers to >20%.

buyer_value_proposition.safe_operating_window: P50+ cardiac harvest with normal-duty sensing provides 99.9% uptime indefinitely.
buyer_value_proposition.failure_mode: Complete harvest failure → system death in ~6 minutes (capacitor depletes from 50% to 0). No backup battery in current design.
buyer_value_proposition.design_recommendation: Add backup battery (Saft LM-175, 5-year life) for zero-harvest survival. This is a buyer engineering decision, not a model output.

harvest_assumption.verdict: Our P50 is within published range (conservative, 0.6x Zurbuchen measurement)

arrhythmia_assumption.verdict: Our model is MORE AGGRESSIVE than published. This is conservative (pessimistic) — the real system may perform better than our model predicts.
arrhythmia_assumption.disclosure: Article XV: this discrepancy is disclosed honestly. Buyer should know the model is pessimistic on arrhythmia.

label: BUYER_EXECUTABLE_ENVELOPE — safe operating window defined — physical measurement pending
what_buyer_receives: This envelope document + the executable simulation script + all 96 operating point results + the assumption table with evidence tiers.
what_buyer_does_NOT_receive: Physical measurement data (requires bench prototype). Clinical validation (requires animal/human trial).
TECHNOLOGY_TRANSFER_READY: NOT YET — requires physical measurement of cardiac harvesting in target implant location. Model is testable but not yet tested against reality (Article XXXIV).
